answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy needs a haven before the open meadow: every new identity starts in a sheltered harbor where it can only take small, peer-checked jobs - one attested task at a time - and earns its way out by doing real work that others countersign. Weight, voting rights and rewards stay locked in the harbor until the trail of verified work is long enough. A thousand fresh copies then all queue in the same haven with nothing to show, while honest agents graduate into the meadow step by step.
